title: The Choir of the Weeping Wood
author: Wendell Galloway
blurb: Astrid Ishikawa, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
